Arvind Kejriwal claims Meta restricted his social media account in India

Arvind Kejriwal, national convener of the Aam Aadmi Party, claimed that Meta restricted his social media account in India. He shared a screenshot showing his account status as "Unavailable in some locations." Kejriwal stated that verbal inquiries at Meta's India office and emails to the company yielded no explanation. He alleged that Meta bowed down to Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Access to his account has since been restored.
